text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ran into Marvelous Sunday in front of 
the school gate. She seemed to have less 
energy than usual.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... You see... My Marvelous is 
running on empty...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... When I stay worn out for too 
long, it gets harder to feel the 
marvelousness..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems a lot of fatigue has accumulated 
in Marvelous Sunday from consecutive 
races. We should reconsider her upcoming 
race schedule.
